# ==============================================================================
# Tide vs sensor models – Kānewai & Kalauhaihai
# Linear / Quadratic / Cubic / Quartic  ±  Day/Night
# ==============================================================================

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
# ---- 1. Load data ------------------------------------------------------------
sensor_data <- read_csv(
  here("cleaned_data/master_data_pivot.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

tide_data <- read_csv(
  here("cleaned_data/honolulu_tide_10min.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    date_time_hst = force_tz(as.POSIXct(date_time_hst), tzone = "Pacific/Honolulu")
  )
```


```{r}
# ---- 2. Join tide to sensors (both sites) ------------------------------------
combined <- sensor_data %>%
  filter(variable %in% c("pH", "oxygen", "temperature")) %>%
  left_join(
    tide_data %>% rename(tide_m = water_level_m),
    by = "date_time_hst"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tide_m), !is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(
    hour   = hour(date_time_hst),
    is_day = hour >= 6 & hour < 18
  )

cat("Rows after join:\n")
print(table(combined$site, combined$variable))
```


```{r}
# ---- 3. Fit all models -------------------------------------------------------
results <- combined %>%
  group_by(site, variable) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    df <- .x

    models <- list(
      linear        = lm(value ~ tide_m, data = df),
      quadratic     = lm(value ~ poly(tide_m, 2, raw = TRUE), data = df),
      cubic         = lm(value ~ poly(tide_m, 3, raw = TRUE), data = df),
      quartic       = lm(value ~ poly(tide_m, 4, raw = TRUE), data = df),
      linear_day    = lm(value ~ tide_m * is_day, data = df),
      quadratic_day = lm(value ~ poly(tide_m, 2, raw = TRUE) * is_day, data = df),
      cubic_day     = lm(value ~ poly(tide_m, 3, raw = TRUE) * is_day, data = df),
      quartic_day   = lm(value ~ poly(tide_m, 4, raw = TRUE) * is_day, data = df)
    )

    tibble(
      model         = names(models),
      r_squared     = map_dbl(models, ~ summary(.x)$r.squared),
      adj_r_squared = map_dbl(models, ~ summary(.x)$adj.r.squared),
      aic           = map_dbl(models, AIC)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
# ---- 4. Clean results table --------------------------------------------------
results_clean <- results %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(r_squared, adj_r_squared), ~ round(.x, 4)),
    aic = round(aic, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(site, variable, model)

print(results_clean, n = 100)

# ---- 5. Best model per site × variable (by AIC) ------------------------------
best_models <- results_clean %>%
  group_by(site, variable) %>%
  slice_min(aic, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("\n---------- Best model (lowest AIC) per site × variable ----------\n")
print(best_models)
```


```{r}
# ---- 6. Day vs Night correlations --------------------------------------------
day_night_cor <- combined %>%
  group_by(site, variable, is_day) %>%
  summarise(
    correlation = cor(value, tide_m, use = "complete.obs"),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(period = ifelse(is_day, "Day", "Night")) %>%
  select(site, variable, period, correlation, n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = period,
    values_from = c(correlation, n)
  )

cat("\n---------- Day vs Night correlations ----------\n")
print(day_night_cor)
```


```{r}
# ---- 7. vs cubic (tide only) -------------------------
ggplot(combined, aes(x = tide_m, y = value)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.03, size = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x,               colour = "blue", se = FALSE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x, 3),      colour = "red",  se = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(site ~ variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Tide vs Sensor Values",
    subtitle = "Blue = linear, Red = cubic",
    x = "Tide height (m, MLLW)",
    y = "Sensor value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
